_readme: Design branches shown on the GitHub Pages preview (tools/preview.py). Order = order on the chooser page.

designs.label: Option A
designs.name: The owners' design (chosen)
designs.blurb: Chosen by the owners on 5 October 2026. Home page, menu and footer rebuilt to the owners’ own homepage design on 8 October 2026 (Italiana and Montserrat, black booking buttons, new team portraits); other pages follow one at a time.

designs.label: Option B (archived)
designs.name: House Light · inspired by The Lane
designs.blurb: Archived 5 October 2026 and kept for reference; it does not include the owners’ latest content. Quiet and airy: framed portraits on a warm plaster wall, flared capitals, Book always in the sticky strip.

designs.label: Option C (archived)
designs.name: Bronze & Sand · inspired by Yukie Natori New York
designs.blurb: Archived 5 October 2026 and kept for reference; it does not include the owners’ latest content. Bold and graphic: full-width sand and bronze bands, one modern sans, arrow capsules, leader-line menus.

designs.label: Option D (archived)
designs.name: Open Door · inspired by Element Salon
designs.blurb: Archived 5 October 2026 and kept for reference; it does not include the owners’ latest content. Bright and friendly: gold-framed white pages, a two-door hero, a black-and-white team wall, "who does what".
